_meta.description: Full non-MQ135 replay package for the app's demo/testing mode. These are SIX SEPARATE real test sessions, recorded at different times on the bench — they are NOT one continuous recording, so they are kept as separate named streams, each with its own real sample rate. Play each stream independently at its own rate; do not merge rows across streams by index, since they were not captured simultaneously.

combined_mpu_max_tmp_serial.note: richest single session — all three sensors together, real HR/SpO2 acquisition arc from finger-on to lock-on to finger-off

combined_mpu_max_tmp_ble_frames.note: captured directly from a live BLE transmission, includes real quality bitmask and BLE connection state

combined_mpu_max_tmp_battery.note: includes real battery percentage/voltage and the HR-acquire counter climbing before lock-on

_meta.excluded: MQ135 — dropped from the current build after it damaged the main board. Not included in this package at all, per instruction.
_meta.not_yet_available: AHT21 and ENS160 (combo board) have no valid captured readings — AHT21 never completed a successful read (I/O error), ENS160's measurement engine never started on the old unit (STATAS never set). No fabricated data is included for either.
_meta.ble_frame_format: <IIhhhhhhhBB (24 bytes, little-endian): seq, uptime_ms, hr, hrv, spo2, skin_temp_x100, amb_temp_x100, humidity_x100, aqi_raw, battery_pct, quality
